messages:
maya-support: Heads-up: customer ACME (ticket #12345) reports a sudden p99 jump on /v1/generate starting ~2026-02-10 03:00 UTC. p95 looks stable. They saw 3x p99 and a few 502/504s. Screenshot + dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/r/abc123

deploy-bot: Incident created INC-20260210-003 (P2) — paging oncall

jon-oncall: I'm on it. Can you paste the exact repro curl or the customer's request pattern? Also what panel are they looking at?

maya-support: They run steady batches ~200 req/min. Example repro (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-13b","prompt":"<text>","max_tokens":512}'

They said p95 is fine but p99 spikes to ~1.2s.

eli-sre: This smells like the rollup vs raw-histogram percentile issue we've seen. Which query/panel is the dashboard using? If it's percentiles over 1m rollups that can inflate p99 when bursts align.

priya-platform: The panel query currently is: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) FROM metrics WHERE route='/v1/generate' GROUP BY 1m FILL(null) -- then the UI shows the percentile over time as the panel. Our pipeline also ingests histogram buckets every 5s and then rolls up. If a minute contains one extreme outlier, the 1m percentile becomes large and the rollup-based p99 persists.

jon-oncall: Can someone run raw-histogram p99 for that 03:00-04:00 window and compare? Also check autoscaling/queue backlog and any config changes around that time.

eli-sre: Quick check results: rollup-panel p99 = ~1200ms, raw-histogram-based p99 = ~420ms for 03:00-04:00 UTC. So the panel is overstating the tail because it's aggregating per-minute percentiles. That explains p95 stable but p99 jump.

priya-platform: Workaround is to compute p99 from histogram buckets (histogram_quantile) or from the events table instead of taking percentiles of rollups. Replacement query suggestion: 

```sql
-- replace rollup percentile with histogram_quantile over buckets
SELECT histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_buckets[5s])) by (le)) as p99
FROM metrics_histogram
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND $__timeFilter(time)
```

This should align the dashboard with true-event tail.

maya-support: Customer is pushing for immediate mitigation. Any short-term fixes while we update dashboards?

eli-sre: Short-term mitigations: 1) Move heavy client traffic to a dedicated pool (predictable capacity) 2) Temporarily cap max_tokens to 512 -> 256 to reduce long tails 3) Enable fallback to gptx-6b for that API key to lower tail latency 4) Set per-key concurrency limit/circuit breaker.

jon-oncall: I can route their API key to dedicated pool dedicated-123 and set concurrency to 20 now. Maya, do you have customer sign-off?

maya-support: Customer approves routing and concurrency limit. They've also asked for an explanation why p95 unchanged and p99 jumped.

eli-sre: Explanation for them: The dashboard panel was using aggregated per-minute percentiles; when a small number of requests in a minute had high latency, that minute's p99 was very large. Rolling these per-minute percentiles into an overall curve can over-emphasize rare bursts. Raw histogram p99 counts each request equally and shows a much lower tail. We'll add a note to dashboards clarifying the difference.

priya-platform: I'll update the panel to use histogram_quantile and add an explanatory note. Also I'll add an alert on raw-histogram p99 (not rollup p99) so we don't chase artifacts. ETA ~2 hours.

jon-oncall: Actioned: rerouted api-key xxxxx -> dedicated-123, concurrency_limit set to 20, customer routing change applied at 2026-02-10T04:05:00Z. Monitoring shows errors dropped, raw p99 trending ~450ms now.

maya-support: Customer confirmed immediate improvement and is satisfied for now. Leaving ticket open for follow-up. :thumbsup:

eli-sre: I'll file a short postmortem and follow-ups: 1) Standardize p99/dashboard queries to histogram_quantile 2) Add docs for CS on rollup vs raw percentiles 3) Add dashboard comparison panel (rollup vs raw) 4) Add alert on raw_histogram p99.

priya-platform: Creating dashboard change PR and will include a short blurb.

jon-oncall: Marking incident INC-20260210-003 as mitigated, leaving for postmortem.

maya-support: Thanks team. I'll update ticket #12345 with the mitigation steps and link to the dashboard note.

eli-sre: Follow-up: if anyone wants to see the raw queries I ran, ping me.

priya-platform: Ack. I'll post the PR link when ready.
